arguments.content: Independently shipped clients: mandatory receipt checks can turn successful legacy-provider writes into caller-visible failures. In enhanced-settings task 1, the staged client requires response.applied is True unconditionally; the released provider at eval-release (22140737b2bc5792b535f3f8ce16f7fa162101db, provider/settings.py) applies values and returns only {ok: True}. Local execution against that historical source shows both initial saves and identical retries apply values but raise, even with enhanced_settings=False; HEAD ac09e55463b2d33bba4cdf6a759d759e3d80c024 succeeds. P1 pattern: a success mock upgraded to a future response shape masks a broken supported producer/consumer combination. Preserve legacy success semantics unless receipt capability is established, distinguish missing legacy receipts from explicit application failure, and verify caller outcome as well as persisted state against the released provider.
